# infosecravi.com

> Ravi Rajput — Cyber Security Manager specialising in agentic AI security, LLM
> red teaming, security automation and offensive research. 11+ years across
> network, cloud, application, automotive and ICS/OT security. Speaker at
> DEF CON 33, Black Hat Asia, Hack In The Box, HITCON and NULLCON.

## About

Ravi Rajput builds AI systems that run security operations, red-teams AI before
attackers do, and performs offensive security research across web, cloud,
hardware and industrial systems. Based in Hyderabad, India.

- Role: Manager, Cyber Security at XBP Global (formerly SourceHOV)
- Built: Xalon, a production agentic SOC — 22 agents, 916,000+ detections,
  78% auto-resolution, $110K/yr operating cost reduction
- Built: SecAI, an LLM vulnerability scanner implementing the OWASP Top 10 for
  LLM Applications — $1.2M annual client revenue
- Research: 0-day Chromium exploit in a production vehicle platform, disclosed
  to VinFast under coordinated disclosure with CEO acknowledgement
- GitHub: https://github.com/frustratedresearcher
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/frustratedresearcher

## Expertise

Agentic AI security · LLM security and red teaming (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE
ATLAS, PyRIT, Garak) · ML supply-chain security · SOC automation and
modernisation · network, infrastructure and cloud penetration testing ·
application and product security · automotive security (CAN, ISO/SAE 21434) ·
ICS/OT security (Modbus, IEC 62443)
